author: Instincttttttt
quote: Beautiful graphics, incredible story, the best voice acting in any game, cartoon, or anime. The gameplay itself though is not really good, it's even borderline bad. Super clunky movement and shooting, empty world, you've heard it all before, but the great aspects of the game are so good you can't possibly go below an 8

author: Instincttttttt
quote: This may be my favorite video game of all time. I've never experienced a game age so gracefully

author: Instincttttttt
quote: There's not too much to be said about this game that hasn't already been said. Truly the definitive Resident Evil experience. It captures the scariest aspects as you play Grace and the classic action aspects of Leon. Such a beautiful game as well

author: Instincttttttt
quote:
This game is buggy in ways that killed Cyberpunk, it has levels that play themselves like Wolverine, and on top of all that, it runs at 30 fps max, frequently dipping below into the 20s or even teens.

It is slop fed to little piggies to blind them from steep price increases and the death of physical media, and people genuinely fall for it.

On top of that, critic reviews are clearly paid by Rockstar. 100/100 reviews that open with "it's not a perfect game", written by people who gave OOT a 95/100 and called it "the definitive version" of the "greatest game of all time"

Paid reviews, slop game, eat it up piggies
